photoPrompt: Bigfoot (Sasquatch), a huge shy ape-like forest giant covered in long shaggy dark brown fur, with gentle wary eyes, seen from the chest up in a misty Pacific Northwest pine forest.

en.name: Bigfoot
en.description: Known for his big feet, excellent strength and incredible hiding skills. He is a master of the woods. He spends the day eating and hiding from humans. He is just very shy.

fr.name: Bigfoot
fr.description: Connu pour ses grands pieds, sa force exceptionnelle et ses incroyables talents de camouflage. C'est un maître des bois. Il passe ses journées à manger et à se cacher des humains. Il est tout simplement très timide.
